math_specs.description: When LK-NUM equals 0, LK-FIB is calculated as LK-ANT.
When LK-NUM is not 0 and LK-NUM equals 1, LK-FIB is calculated as LK-ATU.
When LK-NUM is not 0, not 1, and equals 2, LS-PRX is calculated as LK-ANT + LK-ATU.
When LK-NUM is not 0, not 1, and equals 2, LK-FIB is calculated as LS-PRX.
When LK-NUM is not 0, not 1, and not 2, MOVE LK-ATU TO LS-ATU.
When LK-NUM is not 0, not 1, and not 2, LS-NUM is calculated as LK-NUM - 1.
When LK-NUM is not 0, not 1, and not 2, LS-PRX is calculated as LK-ANT + LK-ATU.
math_specs.expression: (NOT (LK-NUM-OLD = 0) AND NOT (LK-NUM-OLD = 1) AND NOT (LK-NUM-OLD = 2)) IMPLIES (LS-PRX-NEW = LK-ANT-OLD + LK-ATU-OLD)

math_specs.description: When LK-NUM is not 0, not 1, and not 2, LK-FIB is calculated as NUMVAL ( FIBBASE ( LS-NUM , LS-ATU , LS-PRX ) ).
math_specs.expression: (NOT ((LK-NUM-OLD = 0))) AND (NOT ((LK-NUM-OLD = 1))) AND (NOT ((LK-NUM-OLD = 2))) IMPLIES (LK-FIB-NEW = NUMVAL ( FIBBASE ( LS-NUM-OLD , LS-ATU-OLD , LS-PRX-OLD ) ))
